newsitem.title: USA: Twenty First Century faces SEC inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Twenty First Century faces SEC inquiry.

text.p: Twenty First Century Health Inc said on Wednesday it "welcomes" the Securities and Exchange Commission inquiry that has led to a 10-day temporary suspension from trading.
The company said it would be able to provide the SEC with information it requires over the next nine days.

Twenty First Century said it agreed to file a new 15C2-11 with the NASD prior to the end of the 10-day period. All other questions regarding recent acquisitions of the company are in the process of being disclosed, the company said.
Twenty First Century Health, which has retained legal counsel for the SEC disclosure inquiry, said it believes the inquiry will not affect its daily business.
Also, the company said it has retained the services of the accounting firm Lazar-Levine to complete its audit report.
